objet: Your memorandum on the Valais tax line
disponibilite: I remain available for a call this week.

corps.p: I have reviewed your memorandum on the Valais succession-tax line.

Your central point is sound. The advance of CHF 436,495 and the assessment of CHF 133,625 leave a balance of CHF 302,870 which the canton itself established in favour of the estate, and nothing in the file records its reimbursement.

There is a further point you do not make. In the inventory of 30 June 2024 the advance is deducted in full, apparently without the corresponding claim being carried on the assets side. If that is right, the estate divided was understated by the same CHF 302,870.

Several of your other items do not hold, among them the alleged understatement of CHF 37,500 and the discrepancy of CHF 32,999.97. I will explain why on the telephone. They should not go to the executor alongside the point that does hold.
One matter is urgent. Please tell me the date on which you first learned of the CHF 302,870 balance. If it is an old one, part of this file may already be out of time.
Subject to that, the first step is a single letter to the Service cantonal des contributions in Sion. It should answer the central question.
